---
title: "Boxscore + Gamelog Prep Pipeline"
output: html_document
params:
  seed: 42
  train_end_date: "2025-12-31"
  valid_end_date: "2026-01-31"
  test_end_date: "2026-03-31"
  random_holdout_pct: 0.0
  random_holdout_label: "holdout"
  use_2025_placeholder: true
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(params$seed)
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

read_csv_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || file.info(path)$size == 0) {
    return(data.frame())
  }
  read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

empty_like <- function(df) {
  df[0, , drop = FALSE]
}

coerce_numeric <- function(df, exclude_cols) {
  out <- df
  num_cols <- setdiff(names(out), exclude_cols)
  for (col in num_cols) {
    out[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(out[[col]]))
  }
  out
}

normalize_loc_flags <- function(df) {
  if (!("loc" %in% names(df))) {
    df$loc <- NA
  }
  if (!("is_home" %in% names(df))) {
    df$is_home <- ifelse(df$loc == "", NA, ifelse(df$loc == "@", 0, ifelse(df$loc == "N", 0, 1)))
  }
  if (!("is_away" %in% names(df))) {
    df$is_away <- ifelse(df$loc == "", NA, ifelse(df$loc == "@", 1, 0))
  }
  if (!("is_neutral" %in% names(df))) {
    df$is_neutral <- ifelse(df$loc == "N", 1, 0)
  }
  df
}
```

## Load Data

```{r load-data}
bs_2024 <- read_csv_safe(file.path("..", "2024", "master_boxscore.csv"))
gl_2024 <- read_csv_safe(file.path("..", "2024", "master_gamelog.csv"))

if (isTRUE(params$use_2025_placeholder)) {
  bs_2025 <- empty_like(bs_2024)
  gl_2025 <- empty_like(gl_2024)
} else {
  bs_2025 <- read_csv_safe(file.path("..", "2025", "master_boxscore.csv"))
  gl_2025 <- read_csv_safe(file.path("..", "2025", "master_gamelog.csv"))
}

bs_2024$season <- "2024"
gl_2024$season <- "2024"
bs_2025$season <- "2025"
gl_2025$season <- "2025"

all_box <- rbind(bs_2024, bs_2025)
all_gl  <- rbind(gl_2024, gl_2025)

all_box$game_date <- as.Date(all_box$game_date)
all_gl$date <- as.Date(all_gl$date)
```

## Clean + Aggregate Boxscores

```{r aggregate-boxscores}
box_totals <- subset(all_box, player == "School Totals")
box_basic <- subset(box_totals, table_type == "basic")
box_adv   <- subset(box_totals, table_type == "advanced")

key_cols <- c("game_id", "game_date", "team", "opponent", "season")

num_cols_basic <- names(box_basic)[sapply(box_basic, is.numeric)]
num_cols_adv   <- names(box_adv)[sapply(box_adv, is.numeric)]

feat_basic <- box_basic[, unique(c(key_cols, num_cols_basic))]
feat_adv   <- box_adv[,   unique(c(key_cols, num_cols_adv))]

prefixed_basic <- feat_basic
prefixed_adv   <- feat_adv

bn <- setdiff(names(prefixed_basic), key_cols)
an <- setdiff(names(prefixed_adv), key_cols)

names(prefixed_basic)[match(bn, names(prefixed_basic))] <- paste0("basic_", bn)
names(prefixed_adv)[match(an, names(prefixed_adv))]     <- paste0("adv_", an)

team_box <- merge(prefixed_basic, prefixed_adv, by = key_cols, all = TRUE)
team_box <- team_box[order(team_box$team, team_box$game_date), ]
```

## Clean + Prep Gamelogs

```{r prep-gamelogs}
all_gl <- normalize_loc_flags(all_gl)

gl_min <- all_gl[, c(
  "sid", "date", "opp_sid", "opp", "res", "tm_score", "opp_score", "ot",
  "is_home", "is_away", "is_neutral", "season"
)]
names(gl_min) <- c(
  "team", "game_date", "opp_sid", "opp_name", "res", "tm_pts", "opp_pts", "ot",
  "is_home", "is_away", "is_neutral", "season"
)
```

## Join + Targets

```{r join-targets}
team_games <- merge(team_box, gl_min, by = c("team", "game_date", "season"), all.x = TRUE)
team_games$win <- as.integer(team_games$res == "W")
team_games$score_diff <- team_games$tm_pts - team_games$opp_pts

id_cols <- c("team", "opponent", "opp_sid", "game_id", "game_date", "season", "res")
team_games <- coerce_numeric(team_games, exclude_cols = id_cols)
```

## Split: Date + Optional Random Holdout

```{r split-data}
train_end <- as.Date(params$train_end_date)
valid_end <- as.Date(params$valid_end_date)
test_end  <- as.Date(params$test_end_date)

team_games <- team_games[!is.na(team_games$game_date), ]

train_df <- subset(team_games, game_date <= train_end)
valid_df <- subset(team_games, game_date > train_end & game_date <= valid_end)
test_df  <- subset(team_games, game_date > valid_end & game_date <= test_end)

if (params$random_holdout_pct > 0 && nrow(train_df) > 0) {
  holdout_n <- floor(nrow(train_df) * params$random_holdout_pct)
  holdout_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(train_df)), size = holdout_n)
  holdout_df <- train_df[holdout_idx, ]
  train_df <- train_df[-holdout_idx, ]
} else {
  holdout_df <- team_games[0, ]
}

split_label <- function(df, label) {
  df$split <- label
  df
}

train_df <- split_label(train_df, "train")
valid_df <- split_label(valid_df, "valid")
test_df  <- split_label(test_df, "test")
holdout_df <- split_label(holdout_df, params$random_holdout_label)

all_splits <- rbind(train_df, valid_df, test_df, holdout_df)
```

## Outputs

```{r outputs}
write.csv(team_games, file = file.path("outputs", "team_games_prepped.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(train_df,   file = file.path("outputs", "team_games_train.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(valid_df,   file = file.path("outputs", "team_games_valid.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(test_df,    file = file.path("outputs", "team_games_test.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if (nrow(holdout_df) > 0) {
  write.csv(holdout_df, file = file.path("outputs", "team_games_holdout.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

data.frame(
  total_rows = nrow(team_games),
  train_rows = nrow(train_df),
  valid_rows = nrow(valid_df),
  test_rows = nrow(test_df),
  holdout_rows = nrow(holdout_df)
)
```
